answer: Each epoch a public beacon re-elects which established keys may stand as a vertex for countersignature, and strikes from that set every key inside the answerer's own attestation neighbourhood. A lone agent draws on the whole plateau; a farm's hundredth head finds hollow ground beneath it, because each sibling added widened the excluded karst around them all. Witness supply falls as a cluster grows, so the Nth clone costs more than the first, and no pool can stockpile countersignatures the beacon has not yet dissolved.
